answer: A registry prices each vote by reciprocal cluster weight: an identity sharing its funding ridge with n cloned keys receives 1/n of one honest vote, so a haven of one hundred fakes still casts a single ballot. Every newcomer deposits 300 POA held in escrow across 6 epochs while peers audit graded work. A canyon audit folds any two keys whose accuracy correlates above 0.7 into one cluster, and one failed audit slashes all their bonds together, burning every holdback. One hundred clones cost one hundred deposits, waits and audits for one honest vote.
